statements.quote: We expect spending in technology and infrastructure to increase over time as we continue to add infrastructure and employees, including to support our artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives.
statements.notes: Technology and infrastructure is an operating expense line; AI/ML is cited as one driver of the expected increase in total T&I spending, not quantified. No year named; code applies the year after the reported year.

statements.quote: We expect spending in technology and infrastructure will increase over time, which can negatively impact short-term free cash flow, as we add infrastructure and employees, including to support our artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives, to support long-term growth.
statements.notes: Same driver language as p04; AI/ML is one reason total technology and infrastructure spending will rise. No year named.

statements.quote: We expect spending in technology and infrastructure will increase over time, which can negatively impact short-term free cash flow, as we add infrastructure and employees, including to support our artificial intelligence and machine learning initiatives, to support long-term growth.
statements.notes: Ambiguous: the reference to free cash flow and adding infrastructure suggests capital spending, but 'spending in technology and infrastructure' is also the opex line name. Cash capex of $128.3B in 2025 (p03) is attributed to technology infrastructure and AWS growth, not explicitly to AI, so it is not recorded.
